issues.location: soundness proof, induction step axiom cases
issues.finding: The induction base handles tautological, K, optional Dual and added-system axiom instances, but the inductive step repeats only the tautological and added-system cases before assuming MP or Nec. A proof of length greater than one can end with a K or optional Dual axiom instance, so the displayed case split is incomplete.
issues.proposed_resolution: Include K and optional Dual axiom instances in the inductive step's cases handled as in the base step.

translation_treatment: Translated the soundness theorem and proof with the missing K and optional Dual induction cases made explicit.
